reasons.label: Match result
reasons.text: Real Madrid CF are favoured at 67%, against 15% for PSV and 18% for the draw. Real Madrid CF carry 173 more Elo points into the match. Over the last five: Real Madrid CF 1.8 points per game, PSV 0.8. They average 2.5 points per game at home this season.

reasons.label: Goals
reasons.text: The model expects 3.83 goals, which puts it over 2.5 at 74%. Across their last five, Real Madrid CF and PSV have scored 1.7 and conceded 1.8 a game between them. Real Madrid CF are the sharper of the two in front of goal right now, not PSV.

reasons.label: Self-correction
reasons.text: Adjusted from this competition's own record: goals were predicted 3.11 against 3.63 actual across 182 settled forecasts, so the rate is nudged up 16.9% to stop the model leaning under.

limitations: Only 3 league matches of this season behind the weaker-evidenced side, so form leans on last season.
